source: User decisions and follow-up answers in current chat

schedule.intent: Complete the agreed scope within the 30-day plan; user expects current progress to allow completion.
schedule.workbook_sync_status: pending; original workbook has not yet been synchronized with the new requirements

model.budget: No user-specified limit currently; track actual usage and costs.
model.note: Preference is recorded; no assumption that the display label is an API model ID.

decision_policy.preference: Model should make as many gameplay decisions as practical, including urgent responses.
decision_policy.fallback_policy: Minimize strategic rule takeover; any fallback must be explicit, logged and counted separately from model decisions.

first_release.entry: User completes card selection and starts the game; Agent takes over the active battle.
first_release.optional_features_condition: Consider after core scope if time permits; not required for first-release acceptance.

failure_video_analysis.delivery: Software accepts a video and uses an integrated LLM to produce the analysis and panel.

human_control.takeover_method: User presses the stop hotkey before taking control.
human_control.stop_semantics: Stop Agent input; do not pause the game.
human_control.resume_policy: Explicit restart with fresh observation and validation; never replay old actions.

acceptance.interpretation: User-confirmed release criterion for this small series, not a guarantee of an 80% long-run win rate.

integration_checks: Verify exact model API ID, account access, endpoint and credentials at integration.
Confirm video analysis input path supported by the actual model/API; preserve video timestamps and source evidence.
Retest current focus behavior and capture/input geometry using live observations.
